subject: 5 AI tools cutting hours from your Monday

body:
This week we found tools that automate the boring stuff — so you can focus on growing your business instead of running it.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI** — Your second brain, now with superpowers. Summarize meeting notes, draft project plans, and brainstorm ideas without leaving your workspace. Best for teams drowning in docs. Free to try, $10/mo for AI features. [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Zapier** — Connect your apps and automate workflows without a single line of code. This week's standout: their new AI-powered workflow builder that writes automations from plain English. Free plan available. [Try Zapier Free →](https://zapier.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

**HubSpot** — The free CRM just got smarter. AI now drafts follow-up emails, scores your leads, and flags deals at risk — all from your existing pipeline data. [Try HubSpot Free →](https://hubspot.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

## Quick Tip

Before buying any new AI tool, run this 3-minute test: describe your #1 time-wasting task and ask the tool's chatbot or AI assistant to solve it. If it can't solve that in the demo, it won't solve it in production.

See you next Monday.
